'''Galactic Alliance Security assault speeders''' were a type of [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] in use by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]]' [[Galactic Alliance Security|Security]] force around [[43 ABY]]. It was equipped with at least one [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] turret.
